_comment: Ticket #268. Sophisticated Storage registers pump_upgrade, advanced_pump_upgrade and xp_pump_upgrade in ModItems and enables all three in sophisticatedcore-common.toml, but ships no recipe for any of them, in either direction of its usual storage<->backpack conversion pairs. The reason is upstream: PumpUpgradeWrapper and XpPumpUpgradeWrapper both read IStorageWrapper.getFluidHandler(), whose default body returns Optional.empty(); Sophisticated Backpacks overrides it through its Tank Upgrade, Sophisticated Storage never does and has no Tank Upgrade at all. These three upgrades are therefore inert in a chest or barrel. Recipes added anyway on request, mirroring the Sophisticated Backpacks recipe for the same item with the storage upgrade base, so the quest chain in config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/sophisticated.snbt stops being a dead end. Kept in the arcadia namespace rather than sophisticatedstorage so a future mod release that ships its own recipe is not silently overridden.
